description: Start introducing your little ones to strawberries, bananas, and other whole, fresh foods safely with the OXO Tot Silicone Self-Feeder. Simply place the food in the large-capacity pouch and let your little one do the rest! The silicone is easy to clean (really!) and the childproof lock is easy for grown-ups to take apart. target_product.review_text:
Between all our children we have several different feeders including the mesh ones. I find mesh ones to be very difficult to clean, even after boiling it just doesn’t feel clean with all the discoloration and food particles being stuck in there. That is not the case with the silicone feeders.

Between different feeders we have OXO has the softest nipple and overall it is made by better quality materials. Handle is on the larger side which allows for more gripping space for the baby. Handles on my other feeders are made out of plastic but OXO is made out of softer material which allows for a better grip (especially green area of the handle)

MOST IMPORTANT
Holes in the nipple are positioned just right - top of the nipple only. This is important because nipple is large and the baby obviously can’t put it all in her mouth. If nipple has a large area covered in holes and baby is not able to take it all then the food will start seeping out of those holes that are not in the baby’s mouth and make a big mess. Not only mess, most food will end up on baby’s clothes not in her belly. I hope that makes sense.

My other feeders come with a 3 different sizes of nipples that grow with the baby while OXO has only one size. I wish they would do the same.

Overall it’s superior quality feeder and very well thought out. I rate if 5 stars.
